metric_definitions.ndcg@5: Graded gains 2^grade - 1 with log2(rank + 1) discounts, cutoff 5; ideal ordering uses the complete judgment pool.
metric_definitions.ndcg@10: Graded gains 2^grade - 1 with log2(rank + 1) discounts, cutoff 10; ideal ordering uses the complete judgment pool.
metric_definitions.ndcg@20: Graded gains 2^grade - 1 with log2(rank + 1) discounts, cutoff 20; ideal ordering uses the complete judgment pool.
metric_definitions.ndcg@50: Graded gains 2^grade - 1 with log2(rank + 1) discounts, cutoff 50; ideal ordering uses the complete judgment pool.
metric_definitions.precision@5: Relevant papers in the first 5 positions, divided by 5 even when fewer papers are returned.
metric_definitions.precision@10: Relevant papers in the first 10 positions, divided by 10 even when fewer papers are returned.
metric_definitions.precision@20: Relevant papers in the first 20 positions, divided by 20 even when fewer papers are returned.
metric_definitions.ap@10: Sum of precision@rank at relevant hits in ranks 1–10, divided by min(10, total relevant judgments); zero if no relevant judgments.
metric_definitions.map@10: Unweighted source-group mean of per-query AP@10.
metric_definitions.ap@20: Sum of precision@rank at relevant hits in ranks 1–20, divided by min(20, total relevant judgments); zero if no relevant judgments.
metric_definitions.map@20: Unweighted source-group mean of per-query AP@20.
metric_definitions.ap@50: Sum of precision@rank at relevant hits in ranks 1–50, divided by min(50, total relevant judgments); zero if no relevant judgments.
metric_definitions.map@50: Unweighted source-group mean of per-query AP@50.
metric_definitions.pairwise_accuracy@50: Scored, explicitly judged papers within the first 50 ranks: unordered pairs with unequal grades; 1 for correct score order, 0 for reversal, 0.5 for an exact score tie. Equal-grade pairs are excluded. No comparable pairs yields null; means omit null queries and report the valid count.
metric_definitions.mrr@50: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant paper within ranks 1–50; zero if no relevant paper appears within that cutoff.

baseline_combined_development.protocol: Per-query judged candidates only; no title override; binary relevance >=2 for Precision, reciprocal rank and AP. Cutoffs follow evaluation_configuration; pairwise accuracy uses graded judgments and raw score ties.

config.development_pooling: one unweighted macro mean across 10 synthetic and 2 human query pools

manifest.limitations: Both human and synthetic evaluation queries select the checkpoint; subsequent scores on them are development performance. Training/development paper overlap is preserved and audited.
